study: de-novo bounded expression synthesis, not repair-template/operator mutation
domains: integer x -30..30; magnitude abs(x), quadratic x*x-1, affine3*x+2; synthetic author-known functions
grammar: terminals x,-1,0,1,2,3; unary abs(expression); binary +,-,*; AST node cost<=5; generated by increasing cost, abs first then operators +,-,* then left-cost ascending, prior enumeration order for children; exact source text deduplication, no algebraic pruning
budget: max512 unique expressions per task INCLUDING terminals, same ordered pool each task; no model; sequential task order magnitude,quadratic,affine; evaluate all capped expressions using dev-only exact task score; choose highest dev score then lower node cost then lexical expression text; no early stopping; max1536 task-candidate evaluations
gate: M5 pinned complete-report baseline-case-preservation gate, baseline constant0 functions
evaluation: 15 dev cases (5/task) and168 eval cases (56/task), mechanically input-disjoint; eval consulted once after all selection
hypothesis: bounded compositional grammar can build multi-node expressions without a full-function fix template; it may exhaust budget before solving some targets
limits: synthetic known finite arithmetic-expression grammar; not arbitrary program invention or AGI
no LLM/generalization/runtime speedup or broad synthesis advantage claim
author-visible expected answers, proposer eval-input-unseen, worker inputs only
no git-timestamp proof of absence of private scoring
no cgroup/kernel/covert-channel guarantee; no activation authority
budget/order strongly constrains outcomes; all losses/exhaustion retained
